# About the course

This course introduces practical approaches to analysing biological data using
R, command-line tools and remote computing. You will learn to organise your
work, run bioinformatics analyses and explain your results in reproducible reports.

# Before you start

- Follow the course instructions for connecting to CREATE and opening RStudio.
- Keep your files in a dedicated folder for each practical.
- Read each tutorial step before running its commands.
- Use the course announcements for session details, deadlines and submission instructions.

# Tutorials

## Reproducible research with R

Organise your analysis and combine code, results and explanations in a notebook.

[Open the tutorial](rres/rresearch_tutorial.html)

## Sequencing technologies

Work with sequence data, run analysis tools and interpret their outputs.

[Open the tutorial](seq_tech/seq_tech_tutorial.html)

## Alignments: BLAST and HMMER

Explore sequence similarity and use search results to investigate biological questions.

[Open the tutorial](alignments/alignments_tutorial.html)

# Working through the practicals

1. Run the steps in order and check the output at each stage.
2. Record your commands and answer the questions in your own words.
3. Save your work regularly. If a command fails, keep the error message and ask for help.
4. Complete any self-study tasks specified in the tutorial.
